annotations.title: Get the embed code of a chatbot

description:
Get the embed code of a chatbot

The code that puts the chatbot on a website, as the dashboard offers it: `scriptCode` adds a floating chat button before `</body>`, `iframeCode` places the chat inside a container, `publicUrl` is a direct link to the chat. Only chatbots of your own account.
